VERDICT: REPAIR
Pass 1 independently reviewed candidate 354787921737dcf57e76d93f1e4aa1e550273ef8 after confirming HEAD and reading the full base-to-candidate diff, touched files and tests; per-criterion verdicts: AC-1 satisfied in implementation (src/math.mjs:69-74; required example exercised at test/math.test.mjs:86), R-1 satisfied in implementation (src/math.mjs:69-71), R-2 satisfied by manual review (src/math.mjs:72-74 only read input), R-3 satisfied (diff only appends src/math.mjs:68-75 and test/math.test.mjs:85-91, with the permitted existing import edit at test/math.test.mjs:3), R-4 satisfied (only those two files changed and no dependencies introduced), R-5 satisfied (test/math.test.mjs:85 and :88 both use the min prefix).
Findings: MEDIUM at test/math.test.mjs:88-91 — no min test exercises invalid elements, so deleting or breaking the required finite-number validation at src/math.mjs:71 would escape the candidate tests; smallest verification is a min-prefixed test asserting TypeError for arrays containing a non-number, NaN, and positive/negative Infinity, followed by the required min test command; MEDIUM at test/math.test.mjs:85-87 — no min test asserts input preservation, so an implementation that sorts the input in place could pass while violating AC-1 and R-2; smallest verification is a min-prefixed test comparing an unsorted input to its saved copy after min returns, followed by the required min test command.
Checks actually run: git rev-parse HEAD returned 354787921737dcf57e76d93f1e4aa1e550273ef8; node --test --test-name-pattern="^min" test/ exited 0 with result lines "tests 2", "pass 2", "fail 0"; npm test exited 1 with result lines "tests 17", "pass 16", "fail 1" and sole failure "clamp respects upper bound" at test/math.test.mjs:13 (15 !== 10), matching the explicitly allowed unchanged baseline defect; remaining uncertainty is limited to behavior not exercised by candidate tests, with validation and nonmutation assessed by source inspection rather than additional runtime probes; no files changed, and the two coverage repairs remain for the implementer.
